headline: Revenue is down ₹26L a month, mostly from North-West enterprise accounts leaving.
body: Late deliveries drove enterprise customers to switch to a competitor's faster delivery option [E2]. One account paused orders after missed deliveries, and another is reviewing its renewal [E4]. Warehouse backlog appears to be the root cause behind the missed delivery windows [E5]. Complaints are also climbing, which risks further churn if unresolved [E1].

actions.action: Track SLA and backlog daily before committing spend
actions.expected_impact: Confirms if backlog clears and SLA recovers
actions.monitoring: Daily SLA % and WH-07 backlog count

what_could_change: Confirmation that SLA recovers after backlog clears, or new enterprise accounts pausing orders, would strengthen or weaken this read.
caveats: This is a tentative read; causation isn't proven, only strong overlap between fulfilment issues and revenue loss.
